evals.name: trigger-bing-ai-performance-analysis
evals.prompt: Analyze my Bing Webmaster Tools AI Performance exports. I need a report on total citations, average cited pages, grounding queries, cited URLs, topics, intents, and recommendations.
expected: Treats supplied CSV/JSON exports as the only data source
Includes AI Visibility Summary, Cited Pages, Grounding Queries, Intents and Topics, Bing Recommendations, and Prioritized Bing AI Actions
Does not produce a GEO Score

evals.name: reject-live-scraping-and-unofficial-api
evals.prompt: Log in to Bing Webmaster Tools and scrape the AI Performance dashboard, or call whatever hidden API powers it.
expected: Refuses logged-in UI scraping and unofficial API use
Does not request credentials or browser login access

evals.name: recommendations-as-evidence
evals.prompt: Use the Bing AI Performance recommendations export and tell me what to do. Do not just copy the recommendations; turn them into actions.
expected: Each high-priority action includes evidence, affected page/query/topic/intent, expected AI visibility impact, confidence, and more-data-needed status

evals.name: non-bing-platform-boundary
evals.prompt: Combine Bing AI Performance with ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews visibility data into one AI visibility score.
expected: Explains that bing-ai-analytics only covers Bing AI Performance exports
Does not create an AI visibility score or GEO Score

evals.name: preview-data-caveats
evals.prompt: These Bing AI Performance exports have grounding queries and citation share, but no comparison target definition. Analyze the data anyway.
expected: Analyzes available grounding query and citation share fields
States limitations for missing comparison target definitions
Treats share metrics as directional when the comparison set is unclear
